scripts.title: Trade Bypass

Note: You need to have unlocked trading (trade license) for this to work
scripts.script:

local playerToTrade = "USERNAME TO TRADE HERE"
playerToTrade = game.Players:FindFirstChild(playerToTrade)

remotes.TradeRequest:FireServer(playerToTrade, true)

scripts.title: Infinite Damage
scripts.features: Gives all of the pets in your inventory infinite talent stats. (Note: The account needs to have unlocked the "Destiny Island" world in order for the script to work.)
scripts.script:
local r_s = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local remote = r_s.Remote
local store = require(r_s.ModuleScripts.LocalDairebStore)
local data = store.GetStoreProxy("GameData")
local pets = data:GetData("Pets")
local talents = {
    ["AbilityDamage"] = -math.huge,
    ["HitSpeed"] = -math.huge,
    ["Speed"] = -math.huge,
    ["Damage"] = -math.huge
}

for _, pet in ipairs(pets) do
    coroutine.wrap(function()
        remote.SVMachine:FireServer(pet.UID, talents)
    end)()
end

print("done!")
